爱: to love; to be fond of; to like; affection
北京: Beijing, capital of the People's Republic of China
不: no; not so; (bound form) not; un-
吃: to eat; to consume; to eat at (a cafeteria etc)
大: big; large; great; older (than another person)
对不起: I'm sorry; excuse me; I beg your pardon; to let (sb) down; to disappoint
多: many; much; too many; in excess
个: used in 自个儿; (classifier used before a noun that has no specific classifier)
工作: to work; (of a machine) to operate
和: old variant of 和; surname He
后面: the back; the rear; the last bit; behind; near the end; at the back
会: can; to have the skill; to know how to; to be likely to; to be sure to
家: used in 家伙 and 家俱; home
开: to open (transitive or intransitive); (of ships, vehicles, troops etc) to start
看: to look after; to take care of
看见: to see; to catch sight of
块: lump; chunk; piece; classifier for pieces of cloth, cake, soap etc
来: to come; (used as a substitute for a more specific verb)
了: (completed action marker); (modal particle indicating change of state, situation now)
没: (negative prefix for verbs) have not; not; drowned
呢: particle indicating that a previously asked question is to be applied to the preceding word ("What about ...?", "And ...?"); particle for inquiring about location ("Where is ...?")
你: you (informal, as opposed to courteous 您); you (Note: In Taiwan, 妳 is used to address females, but in mainland China, it is not commonly used. Instead, 你 is used to address both males and females.)
去: to go; to go to (a place)
热: to warm up; to heat up
上: used in 上声; (bound form) up; upper; above; previous
是: to be (followed by substantives only); correct; right; true
睡觉: to go to bed; to sleep
岁: variant of 岁, year; years old
他: he; him (used for either sex when the sex is unknown or unimportant); (used before sb's name for emphasis)
听: smile (archaic); to listen to; to hear
同学: to study at the same school; fellow student
喜欢: to like; to be fond of
想: to think (about); to think of; to devise
些: classifier indicating a small amount or small number greater than 1: some, a few, several
有: to have; there is; (bound form) having; with; -ful; -ed; -al (as in 意 intentional)
在: to exist; to be alive; (of sb or sth) to be (located) at
这: (pronoun) this; these; (bound form) this; the (followed by a noun)
做: to make; to produce; to write; to compose
